what: SLOOP's four-track groovebox on the SMK-37, in three builds. Mewcoder turns track 3 into a 20-channel vocoder after the Sennheiser VSM201, with two routed USB audio inputs. Mewcoder + Harmoniser adds three harmony voices after the Eventide H949. Multichannel sends six USB audio stems to your DAW.
author: MiloMeowzers
